tema: Obligation in the Past — Had To, Should Have, Was Supposed To, Needn't Have

cast_dialogue.linea: Past obligations and past regrets, heroes: what we HAD to do, what we SHOULD have done, and what we NEEDN'T have worried about.
I was supposed to arrive at eight, but I had to work late. I should have called!
I was supposed to help Sofía with the chairs. I should have been there. Sorry!
Don't worry. You needn't have brought anything anyway — Abuela Carmen had cooked everything.
You shouldn't have worried about the food, mis héroes. But Ben... you ought to have apologized earlier!

banco_oraciones.oracion: I had to work late last night.
He was supposed to arrive at eight.
You needn't have worried about the food.
We didn't have to pay in advance.
Did you have to work late?
Was he supposed to bring the music?
Did you have to go? Yes, I did.
Was she supposed to help? Yes, she was.
Should they have waited? No, they shouldn't have.

inicio.definicion_pragmatica: Past obligation: had to (necessary), was/were supposed to (expected plan, often unfulfilled), should/ought to have + participle (regret or criticism), needn't have + participle (done but unnecessary), didn't have to (not necessary, often not done).

filas: He was supposed to arrive at eight.

ejercicios.pregunta: I was supposed to arrive at eight, but I ___ work late.
You ___ called me! I was worried. (reproach)
You ___ worried about the food — Carmen cooked everything. (unnecessary)

ejercicios.afirmacion: 'Was supposed to' often describes a plan that didn't happen.
After 'should have' we use the infinitive, not the participle.

ejercicios.texto: He was supposed to ___ (help) her with the chairs.
We didn't have to ___ (pay) in advance.

ejercicios.oracion_base: It was necessary for me to work late.
You worried, but it wasn't necessary.

ejercicios.pregunta: Write about a recent event: one thing you had to do, one you should have done, and one you needn't have done.
ejercicios.respuesta: I had to work on Saturday. I should have called my mother. I needn't have bought milk — we had plenty.

guion: Sofía: Ben! You were supposed to arrive at eight. What happened?
Ben: I'm so sorry. I had to work late, and my phone died.
Sofía: You should have called from the office!
Ben: I know, I know. And Kenji? Wasn't he supposed to help you?
Sofía: Yes, but he had to attend a meeting. Luckily, Abuela Carmen had cooked everything.
Ben: I needn't have brought this cake then!
Sofía: Don't be silly. We can never have too much cake. But you ought to apologize to her!

opciones: She had set up the party

reading.texto: Last Saturday, Ben was supposed to arrive at eight, but he had to work late. He should have called, but his phone had died. Sofía had to carry all the chairs alone, though Kenji was supposed to help her. They needn't have worried about the food — Abuela Carmen had cooked everything. In the end, Ben ought to have apologized earlier, but his cake made everyone forgive him.

preguntas.afirmacion: Ben arrived at eight as planned.

partes.parte: A — Completa con had to, was supposed to, should have o needn't have

ejercicios.texto: You ___ worried — everything was fine. (innecesario pero hecho)
It was necessary for me to work late. → (had to)
You worried, but it wasn't necessary. → (needn't have)
It wasn't necessary to pay in advance. → (didn't have to)
